error_message: canonical task prompt snapshot digest mismatch
root_cause: The frozen analyzer first verified the CRLF task-prompt snapshot against its raw file SHA, then hashed decoded CRLF text without universal-newline normalization against the registered LF canonical-text SHA. No snapshot can satisfy both checks.
resolution: Preserved the frozen-analyzer failure and introduced a post-hoc adapter that retains exact raw-byte verification while applying the preregistration builder's CRLF/CR-to-LF canonical text semantics only to task-prompt snapshot decoding.
